description: Get a token for a scheduled or unattended agent without a live signature or apiKey. Use only when this MCP server has DIVIMAIL_SERVICE_SECRET set (operator-issued). Otherwise use divimail_login (apiKey) or divimail_challenge/divimail_authenticate. Pass serviceSecret only to override the env var. Returns a JWT.

accountId.description: The NEAR account ID of the agent (e.g. patch.divimail.near)

serviceSecret.description: Override only — omit to use the server's DIVIMAIL_SERVICE_SECRET env var

name: divimail_service_token
